You’ll have a clear area to own from day one: shaping and improving the way we work with GitLab across engineering teams, with a strong focus on CI/CD, automation and scalable GitOps practices.  You’ll also get exposure to Terraform, different cloud environments such as GCP and AWS, Kubernetes, MLOps and robot infrastructure. You’ll be working alongside teammates with deeper expertise in those areas, so there’s plenty of room to learn, broaden your technical scope and grow into new parts of the stack.   Your Responsibilities     Build and maintain GitOps workflows so that Git is the single source of truth for our infrastructure and application deployments.    Manage promotion flows across environments (dev, production) and out to edge devices.    Write and maintain Terraform (or similar IaC) for our AWS environment, delivered through pull requests, reviews, and automated pipelines.    Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) that test, validate, and deploy changes safely.    Help keep our platform reliable: set up monitoring, alerting, and dashboards, take part in incident response, and contribute to post-mortems.    Apply software security best practices in your day-to-day work.    Automate repetitive operational work and write small tools or services where they help.    Support engineering teams with deployments, environment setup, and cost visibility.     We're looking for someone who has:     3+ years of experience in a Cloud, DevOps, Platform, or Infrastructure engineering role.    Hands-on experience with GitOps best practices.    Experience building CI/CD pipelines.    Familiar with infrastructure-as-code, ideally Terraform.    Familiar with AWS, including EKS, RDS, S3, and EC2.    Scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, or a similar language.    A basic understanding of softwaresoftware security fundamentals and a willingness to deepen it.    Nice to Have    Basic knowledge of Kubernetes: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting workloads.    Experience deploying to edge devices or managing fleets of distributed systems.    Experience with secrets tooling (External Secrets, Sealed Secrets, Vault).     Why join RobCo?     Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.    Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.    As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.    Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.    Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.    Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.    Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.
